pageTitle: Our Work | Dr. Patience Tsavnande Foundation
pageDescription: Explore our programs: Medical Outreach, Educational Support, Food Security, and Annual Memorial Activities. See how we're making a difference.
heroDescription: Through medical outreach, educational support, and food security programs, we continue Dr. Patience's mission of service to humanity.
memorialSectionDescription: Each year on September 15th, we commemorate Dr. Patience's passing with special programs that honor her memory and continue her work.
impactCtaDescription: Your support enables us to reach more communities, treat more patients, educate more students, and feed more families. Every donation brings us closer to realizing Dr. Patience's dream.
